title: Trump says the UFO issue is being looked into; aliens.gov registered

tellings.quote: this talk of disclosure now and Trump is, you know, Trump and Obama engaged in some sort of bizarre mimetic warfare like a couple months ago and Trump's now saying we're looking into the UFO issue.

plain: In 2026, Donald Trump is said to be telling the public that his government is "looking into the UFO issue." Michels says this himself, without naming a source, and adds that a couple of months earlier Trump and Barack Obama had traded public remarks on the subject in what he calls "some sort of bizarre mimetic warfare." He sees it as a sign that disclosure, meaning the long-awaited official release of what the government knows about UFOs, is getting closer.
